title: An app that gauges my ideas
text: An app that helps me gauge my ideas: I say an idea out loud, a panel of AI perspectives researches it and argues about it, and tells me whether to build it and what to test first this week.

competitors.name: ChatGPT
competitors.priceNote: Plus, monthly; the free tier is the real alternative

key.riskiestAssumption: Strangers will pay for, or keep coming back to, another AI idea-judging panel when free chat prompts and cheap validators already exist.
key.notes: The panel's own first check on this idea said the market is crowded and paid for; the user built it for themselves anyway.
key.keyedBy: Kyle, via docs/PRICING.md and the panel's first Brief (text paraphrased; replace with the words from the app)
